name: Bernie Sanders

lean.basis: Independent U.S. senator from Vermont who caucuses with Democrats and calls himself a democratic socialist; ran for the Democratic nomination in 2016 and 2020.

race_2028.basis: Has praised Ocasio-Cortez and toured with her, but has not endorsed a 2028 successor.

sources.title: NBC News: The front-runners to lead Bernie Sanders' movement in 2028

summary: Bernie Sanders, a self-described democratic socialist, has represented Vermont in Congress since 1991 and in the Senate since 2007, and ran for the Democratic presidential nomination in 2016 and 2020. His 2025 Fighting Oligarchy tour with Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez drew huge crowds, and he administered Zohran Mamdani's public oath as New York mayor.

connections.name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
connections.description: She toured with Sanders on the 2025 Fighting Oligarchy tour; he has praised her as a possible successor but not endorsed anyone.

sources.title: NBC News: The front-runners to lead Bernie Sanders' movement in 2028

connections.name: Faiz Shakir
connections.description: Shakir managed Sanders's 2020 presidential campaign and is his chief political adviser.

connections.name: Mike Casca
connections.description: Casca was a senior communications adviser on Sanders's 2020 campaign and deputy chief of staff in his Senate office.

sources.title: Axios: AOC shakes up team ahead of 2028 decision

connections.name: Zohran Mamdani
connections.description: Sanders administered Mamdani's public oath as New York mayor in January 2026; Mamdani counts Sanders among his political heroes.

sources.title: AP via ABC11: Zohran Mamdani sworn in as New York City mayor

connections.name: Michael Bloomberg
connections.description: Rivals in the 2020 Democratic primary: Bloomberg ran ads and debate attacks against Sanders and urged others to drop out to stop him; Sanders accused him of trying to buy the presidency, and his campaign called Bloomberg's general-election help "a hard no". Bloomberg quit in March 2020 after spending over $1 billion.
